state_resources.scope: Full-shell fitted RAM and chip-state preservation only; game continuation, physical DDR behavior and hardware remain independent gates.

game_clock.scope: Fitted game PLL ratios, system domain, forwarded quarter-period SDRAM clock and absence of functional users on its shifted output; framework/JTAG clocks remain separate; not an electrical or hardware execution proof

framework_timing_scope.scope: Inherited Template MiSTer peripheral pin paths left untimed by upstream sys_top.sdc; explicit source-locked scope, not a claim of HDMI/audio/SD/I2C electrical timing. No SDRAM or game-internal clock/path is excluded.
framework_timing_scope.instrumented_jtag_scope: Only instrumented revision: dedicated Intel-generated TAP pins TDI/TMS/TDO lack external cable delays. TCK and internal debug timing remain checked; no game or SDRAM path excluded. Reference full fit 90e053c.

scope: Full MiSTer fit only, with state controls enabled in the production boundary. Complete state RAM/CPU ROM/chip-register and hierarchy/macro gates, all reported scoped timing, fitted PLL and forwarded SDRAM phase are checked. Instrumentation/build identity and ARM-reader policy are stated separately. Firmware execution, physical DDR, runtime continuation, CRT and hardware remain separate gates. No deployment or JTAG operation.
